note: Region profiles for minga-replica. Facts about laws, stores and providers change: every entry carries the date it was checked. Before launch, re-check the ones marked verify with the official source, and talk to a lawyer when money is at stake. This is not legal advice.

ru.name: Russia
ru.web: Next.js + TypeScript, or the user's own stack
ru.receipts: Online payments to individuals need a fiscal receipt under 54-FZ. Use the provider's receipt service (for example YooKassa receipts) or a connected online cash register. Subscriptions: a receipt for every charge.

store_notes.googleplay: Since 26 December 2024 Google Play does not pay out to developers with a Russian bank account and does not process purchases or subscriptions for them. Free apps can still be published. Paid features need another channel (RuStore, the web). verify
store_notes.appstore: Check App Store Connect for current availability and payouts for your developer account and the Russian storefront before planning paid features there. verify
store_notes.rustore: RuStore supports payments and subscriptions through its own SDK. Name up to 50 characters, short description up to 80, full description up to 4,000.

law.rule: Personal data of Russian citizens is recorded, systematised, accumulated and stored in databases located in Russia. Since 1 July 2025 doing this in foreign databases is prohibited outright, including at the moment of collection. Foreign form builders, CRMs, analytics or email tools that store such data abroad are a problem.

Notify Roskomnadzor that you process personal data before you start, publish a personal data processing policy, and collect consent where the law requires it. Cross-border transfer needs its own notification.
Every online payment from an individual produces a fiscal receipt.
Consumer protection law applies to sales to individuals: clear price, a public offer, a working way to cancel and get a refund where due.
Online advertising in Russia must be labelled and registered (erid token) through an operator of advertising data.

trademark.where: fips.ru, open registers: trademarks and applications, Nice classes 9 and 42 for software

reviews: Yandex Maps and 2GIS for local services

global.name: US, EU and the rest of the world
global.web: Next.js + TypeScript, or the user's own stack
auth: Sign in with Apple and Google
global.receipts: Stripe, Paddle and Lemon Squeezy send receipts. Paddle and Lemon Squeezy act as merchant of record and handle sales tax and VAT; with Stripe you handle tax yourself (Stripe Tax helps).

store_notes.appstore: Guideline 4.1 rejects copycats; 4.8: an app that offers third-party or social login must also offer an equivalent privacy-focused login such as Sign in with Apple; 5.1.1(v): apps with account creation must let users delete the account in the app.
store_notes.googleplay: The impersonation and intellectual property policies reject apps that copy another app's name, icon or branding.

law.rule: EU users: lawful basis, privacy policy listing every processor, data processing agreements, deletion on request, cookie consent for non-essential cookies.
US: a privacy policy, state privacy laws such as California's (CCPA/CPRA), clear auto-renewal and cancellation terms for subscriptions.
No fake reviews or testimonials: the FTC rule of 2024 in the US, the consumer laws of the EU.

both: Selling in Russia and abroad: keep Russian users' personal data in a database in Russia (a separate deployment or a separate region of the same app), take payments with a Russian provider for Russian cards and a global one for the rest, and publish to RuStore and the web for paid features in Russia while App Store and Google Play serve the rest. Decide this in replica-architect, not at deploy.
